# sample Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "sample" {
  prefix    = "provider-prefix"
  delimiter = "-"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delimiter` (String) Delimiter joining the prefix and the string defined in resource
- `prefix` (String) String added as a prefix to the resource's string
